responsibility: Central public header for gigi, the GNAT-to-GCC translation layer. It declares the major entry points for converting GNAT entities and types to GCC trees, building and grouping statements, elaboration and profile-update hooks, target-parameter query callbacks exported to Ada code, and a broad set of inline utility predicates/helpers used across translation, making it the shared API contract among decl.cc, trans.cc, utils*.cc, misc.cc, and the Ada front end.
